name: codex-design-bridge
description: Move single-page designs seamlessly between Codex frontend source and editable Figma frames in either direction.

interface.shortDescription: Codex and Figma single-page design round trips.
interface.longDescription: Open or resume the current CDB workspace, create a page from a description, or start with an existing Figma frame. CDB preserves stable element mappings and applies supported visual and structural changes transactionally without using the official Figma connector.
